title: 'Strait of Hormuz has become, as Dmitry Medvedev said, Iran's nuclear weapon' — Christopher Helali, International Secretary of the American Communist Party
text:
'Strait of Hormuz has become, as Dmitry Medvedev said, Iran's nuclear weapon' — Christopher Helali, International Secretary of the American Communist Party"
